lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the branchial region, with spatial density decreasing and blob diameter increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating localized grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity specular highlights on the superior edge and defined shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Primary biological patterning is overlaid by high-contrast surface light caustics, forming a transient, web-like luminance network across the dorsal and lateral regions.
